Hi there,

I am writing to express interest in hiring the 1975 Orsini Veloce for our wedding. We would prefer to collect the vehicle from your garage on Tue 17 Aug 2027 at 10:30 and return it on 18 August 2027 at 12:30. The vehicle should be provided with a chauffeur and decorated with wedding ribbons. I have attached my driving licence.

Sincerely,
Bram Yarrowfield
+70 431 847 4573
